q_gram_c1_01_001.question: Ojalá ___ más tiempo libre el año pasado. (tener)
q_gram_c1_01_001.explanation: After 'ojalá' referring к unrealized past wish, pluperfect сослагательное наклонение (hubiera + past причастие) is required. 'Tuviera' would express present contrary-к-fact wish, не past one.

q_gram_c1_01_002.question: Quizás la situación ___ diferente si hubiéramos actuado antes. (ser)
q_gram_c1_01_002.explanation: 'Quizás' с pluperfect сослагательное наклонение expresses doubt about hypothetical past outcome. The pluperfect сослагательное наклонение 'hubiera sido' is needed потому что condition (si hubiéramos actuado) is also в pluperfect сослагательное наклонение.

q_gram_c1_01_003.question: What does сослагательное наклонение after 'como si' express, и what tenses can follow it?
q_gram_c1_01_003.correct: It expresses an unreal comparison; only the imperfect subjunctive or pluperfect subjunctive can follow 'como si'
wrong: It expresses a real comparison; the present subjunctive or indicative can follow
It expresses purpose; any subjunctive tense can follow 'como si'
It expresses a temporal relationship; only the present subjunctive follows
q_gram_c1_01_003.explanation: 'Como si' (as if) always introduces unreal или hypothetical comparison. Spanish grammar restricts it к имперфект сослагательное наклонение (для present unreal) или pluperfect сослагательное наклонение (для past unreal). The present сослагательное наклонение is never used after 'como si'.

q_gram_c1_01_004.question: Ella actúa como si no ___ nada de lo ocurrido. (saber, imperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_01_004.explanation: After 'como si', имперфект сослагательное наклонение is required к express unreal comparison в present. 'Supiera' is -ra форма от irregular претерит stem sup-. Note: 'supiese' is also grammatically valid но -ra форма is expected answer here.
q_gram_c1_01_004.conjugation_info: saber (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): supiera, supieras, supiera, supiéramos, supierais, supieran

q_gram_c1_01_005.question: Por más que ___ convencerlo, no cambió de opinión. (intentar)
q_gram_c1_01_005.explanation: 'Por más que' (no matter how much) является concessive conjunction который triggers сослагательное наклонение. Since main clause is в претерит ('no cambió'), имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'intentara' is needed в subordinate clause.

q_gram_c1_01_006.question: Ojalá que los dirigentes ___ una solución antes de la crisis. (encontrar, pluperfect subjunctive, ellos form)
q_gram_c1_01_006.explanation: 'Ojalá que' с pluperfect сослагательное наклонение expresses regretful wish about past event который did не happen. The pluperfect сослагательное наклонение is formed с hubieran + past причастие.
q_gram_c1_01_006.conjugation_info: encontrar (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение): hubiera encontrado, hubieras encontrado, hubiera encontrado, hubiéramos encontrado, hubierais encontrado, hubieran encontrado

q_gram_c1_01_007.question: Habla con tanta autoridad como si ___ un experto en la materia. (ser)
q_gram_c1_01_007.explanation: After 'como si', only имперфект или pluperfect сослагательное наклонение is grammatically correct. Since comparison is about ongoing unreal situation (he is не actually expert), имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'fuera' is correct choice.

q_gram_c1_01_008.question: Perhaps they would have arrived on time if the train hadn't been delayed.
q_gram_c1_01_008.correct: Quizás hubieran llegado a tiempo si el tren no se hubiera retrasado.
wrong: Quizás llegaran a tiempo si el tren no se retrasara.
Tal vez llegarían a tiempo si el tren no se retrasó.
Quizás habrían llegado a tiempo si el tren no se retrasaría.
q_gram_c1_01_008.explanation: 'Quizás' с past counterfactual uses pluperfect сослагательное наклонение. The si-clause also takes pluperfect сослагательное наклонение ('hubiera retrasado'). 'Quizás hubieran llegado' is preferred over 'habrían llegado' в formal registers when expressing doubt.

q_gram_c1_01_009.question: Aunque se lo ___ mil veces, jamás lo habría creído. (decir, pluperfect subjunctive, nosotros form)
q_gram_c1_01_009.explanation: The concessive 'aunque' с counterfactual past situation requires pluperfect сослагательное наклонение. The nosotros форма pluperfect сослагательное наклонение 'decir' is 'hubiéramos dicho', using irregular past причастие 'dicho'.
q_gram_c1_01_009.conjugation_info: decir (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение): hubiera dicho, hubieras dicho, hubiera dicho, hubiéramos dicho, hubierais dicho, hubieran dicho

q_gram_c1_01_010.question: Por más que se esforzara, nunca lograba satisfacer las expectativas de su mentor.
q_gram_c1_01_010.correct: No matter how hard he tried, he never managed to meet his mentor's expectations.
wrong: The more he tried, the more he met his mentor's expectations.
Even though he tried hard, he always satisfied his mentor's expectations.
However much effort he makes, he will never meet his mentor's expectations.
q_gram_c1_01_010.explanation: 'Por más que' + имперфект сослагательное наклонение expresses concessive meaning: despite repeated efforts, result was always same. The имперфект tenses ('esforzara', 'lograba') indicate habitual past situation.

q_gram_c1_02_001.question: Apenas hubo ___ la noticia, salió corriendo hacia la estación. (oír, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_001.explanation: The pretérito anterior (hubo + past причастие) используется after temporal conjunctions like 'apenas' (as soon as) к indicate action completed immediately before another past action. The причастие 'oír' is 'oído'.
q_gram_c1_02_001.conjugation_info: oír (pretérito anterior): hube oído, hubiste oído, hubo oído, hubimos oído, hubisteis oído, hubieron oído

q_gram_c1_02_002.question: No bien ___ terminado el discurso, el público estalló en aplausos. (haber, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_002.explanation: 'No bien' (no sooner) triggers pretérito anterior, который uses претерит 'haber' + past причастие. 'Hubo terminado' указывает на speech ended immediately before audience erupted в applause.

q_gram_c1_02_003.question: Donde ___ leyes, los ciudadanos estarán protegidos. (haber, future subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_02_003.explanation: The future сослагательное наклонение ('hubiere') survives в legal и proverbial language. In это legal-style sentence, 'donde hubiere leyes' означает 'wherever there may be laws'. In modern everyday Spanish, present сослагательное наклонение 'haya' would be used instead.

q_gram_c1_02_004.question: In what contexts does the pretérito anterior (hubo cantado) appear in modern Spanish?
q_gram_c1_02_004.correct: Almost exclusively in literary texts, after temporal conjunctions like apenas, en cuanto, no bien, tan pronto como
wrong: In everyday spoken Spanish to express recently completed actions
In formal business correspondence as a replacement for the preterite
In journalism to describe breaking news events
q_gram_c1_02_004.explanation: The pretérito anterior is virtually extinct в spoken Spanish и rare even в writing. When it does appear, it follows temporal conjunctions (apenas, en cuanto, no bien, tan pronto como) и указывает на immediate anteriority к претерит action. In modern usage, simple претерит обычно replaces it.

q_gram_c1_02_005.question: Quien ___ de buena fe, será protegido por la ley. (obrar, future subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_02_005.explanation: The future сослагательное наклонение ('obrare') используется в legal texts и fixed expressions. 'Quien obrare de buena fe' является legal formula meaning 'whoever shall act в хороший faith'. In modern non-legal Spanish, present сослагательное наклонение 'obre' would be used.
q_gram_c1_02_005.conjugation_info: obrar (future сослагательное наклонение): obrare, obrares, obrare, obráremos, obrareis, obraren

q_gram_c1_02_006.question: Apenas hubo ___ la puerta, se dio cuenta de que había olvidado las llaves dentro. (cerrar, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_006.explanation: In pretérito anterior construction 'hubo + past причастие', причастие 'cerrar' is 'cerrado'. This tense marks immediately preceding action before main претерит verb 'se dio cuenta'.

q_gram_c1_02_007.question: Whoever shall violate this provision will be subject to penalties.
q_gram_c1_02_007.correct: Quien contraviniere esta disposición quedará sujeto a sanciones.
wrong: Quien contravenga esta disposición queda sujeto a sanciones.
Quien contravendría esta disposición estaría sujeto a sanciones.
Quien contravino esta disposición fue sujeto a sanciones.
q_gram_c1_02_007.explanation: In legal Spanish, future сослагательное наклонение ('contraviniere') используется для hypothetical future actions в legal provisions. This mirrors archaic English construction 'whoever shall violate'. The modern equivalent would use present сослагательное наклонение 'contravenga'.

q_gram_c1_02_008.question: En cuanto hubo ___ el documento, lo envió por correo certificado. (firmar, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_008.explanation: After 'en cuanto' (as soon as), pretérito anterior 'hubo firmado' expresses который signing was completed immediately before sending. The past причастие 'firmar' is regular: 'firmado'.

q_gram_c1_02_009.question: Adonde fueres, haz lo que vieres.
q_gram_c1_02_009.correct: Wherever you may go, do as you may see (done there). / When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
wrong: Wherever you went, do what you saw.
Where you will go, do what you will see.
If you go away, do what you are told.
q_gram_c1_02_009.explanation: This proverb uses future сослагательное наклонение ('fueres', 'vieres'), который survives в fixed sayings. It is Spanish equivalent 'When в Rome, do as Romans do'. The future сослагательное наклонение here expresses hypothetical future situations в timeless, proverbial way.

q_gram_c1_02_010.question: Si así lo ___ el tribunal, se procederá al embargo de los bienes. (disponer, future subjunctive, él form)
q_gram_c1_02_010.explanation: In legal register, future сослагательное наклонение 'dispusiere' используется в условное наклонение clauses referring к potential future rulings. The stem comes от irregular претерит 'dispuso' → 'dispusier-' + future сослагательное наклонение endings.
q_gram_c1_02_010.conjugation_info: disponer (future сослагательное наклонение): dispusiere, dispusieres, dispusiere, dispusiéremos, dispusiereis, dispusieren

q_gram_c1_03_001.question: De ___ la verdad, no habría aceptado el trabajo. (saber)
q_gram_c1_03_001.explanation: 'De + perfect инфинитив' replaces 'si + pluperfect сослагательное наклонение' в more concise, literary construction. 'De haber sabido' = 'Si hubiera sabido' (Had I known). The perfect инфинитив (haber + причастие) is required для past counterfactuals.

q_gram_c1_03_002.question: Si hubiera estudiado más, ahora ___ un mejor puesto. (tener)
q_gram_c1_03_002.explanation: This является mixed условное наклонение: si-clause refers к past (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение 'hubiera estudiado') while main clause refers к present consequence (условное наклонение 'tendría'). This mixing time frames is characteristic C1-level grammar.

q_gram_c1_03_003.question: What является 'mixed условное наклонение' в Spanish, и when is it used?
q_gram_c1_03_003.correct: A conditional sentence where the si-clause and the main clause refer to different time frames, such as a past condition with a present result
wrong: A conditional that mixes indicative and subjunctive moods in the same clause
A sentence that uses both 'si' and 'cuando' as conditional markers
A conditional that combines two different subjects in the if-clause
q_gram_c1_03_003.explanation: Mixed conditionals break typical time-frame pairing. For example, 'Si hubiera nacido en España (past), hablaría español perfectamente (present)' mixes past unreal condition с present unreal result. This является sophisticated structure tested at C1 level.

q_gram_c1_03_004.question: Si no ___ tan orgulloso, le habría pedido disculpas hace tiempo. (ser, imperfect subjunctive, él form)
q_gram_c1_03_004.explanation: This is another mixed условное наклонение: si-clause describes ongoing character trait (имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'fuera' = if he weren't поэтому proud) и result clause refers к past (условное наклонение perfect 'habría pedido'). The имперфект сослагательное наклонение используется потому что condition is about persistent state.
q_gram_c1_03_004.conjugation_info: ser (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): fuera, fueras, fuera, fuéramos, fuerais, fueran

q_gram_c1_03_005.question: De no ___ por tu ayuda, nunca habríamos terminado a tiempo. (ser)
q_gram_c1_03_005.explanation: 'De no ser por' является fixed expression meaning 'if it weren't для' или 'were it не для'. Unlike other 'de + инфинитив' constructions replacing si-clauses, это expression uses simple инфинитив 'ser' regardless time reference, потому что it является set phrase.

q_gram_c1_03_006.question: Yo que tú, no ___ en ese negocio. (invertir, conditional, yo form)
q_gram_c1_03_006.explanation: 'Yo que tú' (if I were you) is implied условное наклонение который omits si-clause entirely. The main clause uses условное наклонение tense. This colloquial construction is equivalent к 'Si yo fuera tú, no invertiría en ese negocio'.
q_gram_c1_03_006.conjugation_info: invertir (условное наклонение): invertiría, invertirías, invertiría, invertiríamos, invertiríais, invertirían

q_gram_c1_03_007.question: Con un poco más de experiencia, ___ haber conseguido el puesto. (poder)
q_gram_c1_03_007.explanation: 'Con + noun phrase' can replace si-clause к express implied condition. 'Con un poco más de experiencia' = 'Si tuviera un poco más de experiencia'. The main clause uses условное наклонение 'podría' as expected.

q_gram_c1_03_008.question: Had it not been for the interpreter, the negotiations would have failed.
q_gram_c1_03_008.correct: De no haber sido por el intérprete, las negociaciones habrían fracasado.
wrong: Si no fuera por el intérprete, las negociaciones fracasaron.
Sin el intérprete, las negociaciones fracasaban.
De no ser el intérprete, las negociaciones hubieran fracasado.
q_gram_c1_03_008.explanation: 'De no haber sido por' is past version 'de no ser por', using perfect инфинитив для past counterfactual. The main clause uses условное наклонение perfect 'habrían fracasado' к express unrealized consequence.

q_gram_c1_03_009.question: Si ella no ___ tanto, habría disfrutado más del viaje. (quejarse, pluperfect subjunctive, ella form)
q_gram_c1_03_009.explanation: The pluperfect сослагательное наклонение reflexive verb 'quejarse' is 'se hubiera quejado'. In si-clause past counterfactual, reflexive pronoun 'se' precedes auxiliary 'hubiera'.
q_gram_c1_03_009.conjugation_info: quejarse (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение): me hubiera quejado, te hubieras quejado, se hubiera quejado, nos hubiéramos quejado, os hubierais quejado, se hubieran quejado

q_gram_c1_03_010.question: De haberlo previsto, habríamos tomado las medidas oportunas con suficiente antelación.
q_gram_c1_03_010.correct: Had we foreseen it, we would have taken the appropriate measures well in advance.
wrong: If we foresaw it, we would take the appropriate measures in advance.
By having foreseen it, we took the appropriate measures well in advance.
Upon foreseeing it, we had taken the necessary measures sufficiently early.
q_gram_c1_03_010.explanation: 'De haberlo previsto' является literary replacement для 'Si lo hubiéramos previsto' (had we foreseen it). The perfect инфинитив 'haber previsto' указывает на past counterfactual. 'Con suficiente antelación' означает 'well в advance'.

q_gram_c1_04_001.question: El orador señaló, ___, que la reforma era imprescindible. (dicho esto → formal discourse marker, present participle of decir + esto)
q_gram_c1_04_001.explanation: 'Dicho esto' (который said/having said это) является discourse marker using absolute причастие construction. It functions as transitional phrase в formal speech и writing, linking previous point к новый assertion.
q_gram_c1_04_001.conjugation_info: decir (past причастие): dicho — used в absolute причастие constructions: dicho esto, dicho lo cual, dicho de otro modo

q_gram_c1_04_002.question: ___, las cifras demuestran que la economía se está recuperando. (en cualquier caso)
q_gram_c1_04_002.explanation: 'En cualquier caso' (в any case) является formal discourse marker used к introduce conclusion который holds regardless preceding arguments. While 'en todo caso' и 'de cualquier forma' являются similar, 'en cualquier caso' is most formal register option.

q_gram_c1_04_003.question: No hemos recibido respuesta; ___, debemos seguir adelante con el proyecto. (no obstante)
q_gram_c1_04_003.explanation: 'No obstante' (notwithstanding/nevertheless) является formal adversative connector который introduces contrasting idea. It is often used в written и academic Spanish, и its placement after semicolon is typical formal prose.

q_gram_c1_04_004.question: What is difference between 'por consiguiente' и 'en resumidas cuentas' as discourse markers?
q_gram_c1_04_004.correct: 'Por consiguiente' introduces a logical consequence, while 'en resumidas cuentas' introduces a summary or conclusion of everything discussed
wrong: Both are interchangeable and express the same logical relationship
'Por consiguiente' is informal while 'en resumidas cuentas' is formal
'Por consiguiente' introduces a contrast while 'en resumidas cuentas' introduces a cause
q_gram_c1_04_004.explanation: 'Por consiguiente' (consequently/therefore) establishes cause-effect relationship, while 'en resumidas cuentas' (в short/все things considered) synthesizes multiple points into final assessment. They serve different textual functions: logical deduction vs. summarization.

q_gram_c1_04_005.question: La inversión fue arriesgada; ___, los beneficios superaron las expectativas. (ahora bien → however/now then, formal register)
q_gram_c1_04_005.explanation: 'Ahora bien' (however/now then) является formal discourse marker который introduces qualification, nuance, или contrasting perspective к what was just stated. It signals shift в argument without full contradiction.
q_gram_c1_04_005.conjugation_info: Common formal discourse markers: ahora bien (however), dicho esto (который said), este respecto (в это regard), en resumidas cuentas (в short)

q_gram_c1_04_006.question: ___, la propuesta carece de fundamento jurídico suficiente. (a este respecto)
q_gram_c1_04_006.explanation: 'A este respecto' (в это regard) является formal discourse marker который connects current statement к previously mentioned topic. It is more precise than 'al respecto' и signals writer is addressing specific point.

q_gram_c1_04_007.question: Having said that, we must consider the environmental impact of the project.
q_gram_c1_04_007.correct: Dicho esto, debemos considerar el impacto medioambiental del proyecto.
wrong: Diciendo eso, debemos considerar el impacto ambiental del proyecto.
Habiendo dicho, tenemos que considerar el impacto ecológico del proyecto.
Esto dicho, necesitamos considerar el impacto del medioambiente del proyecto.
q_gram_c1_04_007.explanation: 'Dicho esto' is standard Spanish discourse marker для 'having said который / который said'. It uses absolute причастие construction. 'Diciendo eso' would be unnatural в это context as discourse connector.

q_gram_c1_04_008.question: Las medidas adoptadas fueron insuficientes; ___, no se puede negar que representaron un primer paso. (con todo)
q_gram_c1_04_008.explanation: 'Con todo' (nevertheless/even поэтому) является formal concessive connector который acknowledges preceding point while introducing mitigating counterargument. It is less common than 'sin embargo' но preferred в certain academic и literary registers.

q_gram_c1_04_009.question: En resumidas cuentas, el proyecto ha sido un éxito rotundo a pesar de las dificultades iniciales.
q_gram_c1_04_009.correct: In short, the project has been a resounding success despite the initial difficulties.
wrong: In any case, the project was a success in spite of initial problems.
To summarize the accounts, the project succeeded despite early challenges.
As a result, the project turned out to be completely successful despite difficulties.
q_gram_c1_04_009.explanation: 'En resumidas cuentas' (в short/к sum up) является summarizing discourse marker. 'Rotundo' означает 'resounding/emphatic'. The phrase signals который speaker is wrapping up their argument с definitive assessment.

q_gram_c1_04_010.question: Sea ___ fuere, la decisión ya ha sido tomada y no hay vuelta atrás. (como, future subjunctive of ser)
q_gram_c1_04_010.explanation: 'Sea como fuere' (be который as it may) является fixed concessive expression который uses future сослагательное наклонение 'fuere'. The word needed к complete это set phrase is 'como'. This expression survives в formal speech despite general obsolescence future сослагательное наклонение.
q_gram_c1_04_010.conjugation_info: ser (future сослагательное наклонение): fuere, fueres, fuere, fuéremos, fuereis, fueren — survives only в fixed expressions like 'sea como fuere'

q_gram_c1_05_001.question: En un correo formal a un desconocido: 'Le ___ que me informara sobre los requisitos de admisión.' (agradecer, conditional, yo form)
q_gram_c1_05_001.explanation: In formal written correspondence к someone unknown, условное наклонение 'agradecería' softens request, making it more polite than present или future indicative. This register awareness is crucial at C1 level. 'Le agradecería que...' is standard formal request formula.

q_gram_c1_05_002.question: En un texto académico, es preferible escribir: 'Se ___ que los resultados confirman la hipótesis.' (observar)
q_gram_c1_05_002.explanation: Academic Spanish uses impersonal 'se' construction ('se observa que') к maintain objectivity и distance. The first person ('observo') is generally avoided в academic writing в Spanish, unlike в English where 'I' или 'we' may be acceptable.

q_gram_c1_05_003.question: What is key difference between 'tú', 'usted', и 'vos' в terms register и regional usage?
q_gram_c1_05_003.correct: 'Tú' is informal and used in most of Spain and Latin America; 'usted' is formal and universal; 'vos' is informal and used in Argentina, Uruguay, Central America, and parts of Colombia
wrong: 'Tú' is used in Spain only; 'usted' is used in Latin America; 'vos' is archaic and no longer used
'Tú' and 'vos' are identical in meaning and conjugation; 'usted' is only for elderly speakers
'Vos' is more formal than 'usted' and is used in diplomatic contexts
q_gram_c1_05_003.explanation: The three-way distinction reflects both formality и geography. 'Vos' is не archaic но actively used by millions speakers в Río de la Plata region, Central America, и elsewhere. Each форма triggers different verb conjugations, particularly в настоящее время и повелительное наклонение.

q_gram_c1_05_004.question: En Argentina, la forma voseante del presente indicativo de 'tener' es: Vos ___. (tener, voseo, present indicative)
q_gram_c1_05_004.explanation: In Argentine voseo, present indicative формах stress final syllable: vos tenés, vos querés, vos podés. The accent falls на final -és (для -er verbs). This differs от both 'tú tienes' и 'vosotros tenéis'.
q_gram_c1_05_004.conjugation_info: tener (voseo present indicative): vos tenés — compare: tú tienes, vosotros tenéis

q_gram_c1_05_005.question: En una carta de reclamación formal: 'Por la presente, ___ mi más enérgica protesta ante la situación descrita.' (formular)
q_gram_c1_05_005.explanation: In formal complaint letters, 'por la presente' (hereby) стоит перед present indicative к make formal declaration. 'Formulo mi protesta' является performative utterance where act writing constitutes act protesting. The условное наклонение would weaken complaint.

q_gram_c1_05_006.question: Vos ___ venir cuando quieras. (poder, voseo imperative)
q_gram_c1_05_006.explanation: In voseo regions, 'vos podés' replaces 'tú puedes'. The voseo повелительное наклонение -er verbs keeps stress на last syllable с written accent. In informal Argentine speech, это форма is standard.
q_gram_c1_05_006.conjugation_info: poder (voseo present): vos podés — voseo повелительное наклонение формах differ: vos hablá (hablar), vos comé (comer), vos decí (decir)

q_gram_c1_05_007.question: Sentá ___ a mi lado, por favor. (vos, voseo, reflexive imperative of sentarse)
q_gram_c1_05_007.explanation: The reflexive pronoun для 'vos' is 'te', same as для 'tú'. The voseo повелительное наклонение 'sentarse' is 'sentate' (often written as two words в some dialects: 'sentá te'). The reflexive pronoun does не change between tuteo и voseo.

q_gram_c1_05_008.question: I would be grateful if you could send me the requested information at your earliest convenience.
q_gram_c1_05_008.correct: Le agradecería que me enviara la información solicitada a la mayor brevedad posible.
wrong: Te agradezco que me envíes la información cuando puedas.
Agradecería que me mandes la información solicitada lo antes posible.
Le agradeceré que me envíe la información pedida cuanto antes.
q_gram_c1_05_008.explanation: Formal Spanish correspondence uses 'Le agradecería que' + имперфект сослагательное наклонение для polite requests. 'A la mayor brevedad posible' is standard formal expression для 'at your earliest convenience'. Using 'tú' формах или present indicative would be too informal.

q_gram_c1_05_009.question: Los datos ___ por los investigadores deben ser analizados con cautela. (recopilar, past participle, formal academic register)
q_gram_c1_05_009.explanation: In academic register, past причастие phrases ('datos recopilados por...') являются preferred over relative clauses ('datos que fueron recopilados por...') для conciseness. The причастие agrees в gender и number с noun: 'datos' (мужского рода множественного числа) → 'recopilados'.
q_gram_c1_05_009.conjugation_info: recopilar (past причастие): recopilado/recopilada/recopilados/recopiladas — agrees с modified noun в academic constructions

q_gram_c1_05_010.question: Estimado señor Director: Me dirijo a usted con el fin de solicitar una audiencia para tratar un asunto de suma importancia.
q_gram_c1_05_010.correct: Dear Director: I am writing to you in order to request a meeting to discuss a matter of utmost importance.
wrong: Dear Mr. Director: I am reaching out to you to ask for a hearing about something very important.
Esteemed Director: I address you with the purpose of soliciting an audience for treating a matter of great importance.
Dear Sir Director: I direct myself to you to request a meeting about a most important issue.
q_gram_c1_05_010.explanation: 'Me dirijo usted' is standard formal opening в Spanish correspondence (не literal 'I direct myself'). 'Solicitar una audiencia' означает 'к request meeting/hearing'. 'De suma importancia' translates к ' utmost importance'. The formal register requires usted и careful lexical choices.

q_gram_c1_06_001.question: El niño ___ a llorar en cuanto vio al médico. (echarse, pretérito indefinido, él form)
q_gram_c1_06_001.explanation: 'Echarse + инфинитив' означает 'к burst into (doing something)', indicating sudden, often involuntary beginning. In pretérito indefinido, 'echarse' conjugates as 'se echó'. Note: 'ponerse a' would also work here но prompt specifically asks для 'echarse'.
q_gram_c1_06_001.conjugation_info: echarse (pretérito indefinido): me eché, te echaste, se echó, nos echamos, os echasteis, se echaron

q_gram_c1_06_002.question: La situación ___ empeorando con el paso de los meses. (ir + gerund)
q_gram_c1_06_002.explanation: 'Ir + герундий' expresses gradual, progressive development. 'Iba empeorando' emphasizes ongoing, escalating nature deterioration. While 'fue empeorando' could also work (completed gradual process), 'iba' better captures в-progress deterioration over months.

q_gram_c1_06_003.question: Últimamente, los precios ___ subiendo sin parar. (venir + gerund)
q_gram_c1_06_003.explanation: 'Venir + герундий' emphasizes который action has been building up от point в past toward present. 'Últimamente' (lately) triggers это periphrasis потому что it highlights cumulative trajectory price increases leading up к now.

q_gram_c1_06_004.question: What is difference between 'ir + герундий' и 'venir + герундий' as verbal periphrases?
q_gram_c1_06_004.correct: 'Ir + gerund' describes a gradual progression moving forward in time, while 'venir + gerund' describes an accumulating action that has been building from the past toward the present
wrong: They are interchangeable and both mean 'to be doing something progressively'
'Ir + gerund' is used for past actions and 'venir + gerund' is used for future actions
'Ir + gerund' means 'to go doing' literally and 'venir + gerund' means 'to come doing' literally
q_gram_c1_06_004.explanation: The directional metaphor is key: 'ir' moves away от speaker (forward progression), while 'venir' moves toward speaker (accumulation toward present). 'Las quejas van aumentando' (complaints являются gradually increasing) vs. 'Las quejas vienen aumentando desde enero' (complaints have been accumulating since January).

q_gram_c1_06_005.question: La empresa ___ a implementar las nuevas políticas el mes pasado. (ponerse, pretérito indefinido, ella form)
q_gram_c1_06_005.explanation: 'Ponerse + инфинитив' означает 'к start/begin (с determination или effort)'. It implies deliberate beginning. In pretérito indefinido, 'ponerse' conjugates as 'se puso'. The reflexive pronoun is essential к это periphrasis.
q_gram_c1_06_005.conjugation_info: ponerse (pretérito indefinido): me puse, te pusiste, se puso, nos pusimos, os pusisteis, se pusieron

q_gram_c1_06_006.question: El profesor ___ explicando el tema una y otra vez, pero nadie entendía. (andar + gerund)
q_gram_c1_06_006.explanation: 'Andar + герундий' expresses repeated или habitual action, often с nuance aimlessness или persistence. 'Andaba explicando' suggests professor kept explaining repeatedly, perhaps с frustration, который fits context nobody understanding.

q_gram_c1_06_007.question: She had just finished writing the report when her boss called.
q_gram_c1_06_007.correct: Acababa de terminar de escribir el informe cuando su jefe llamó.
wrong: Acaba de terminar de escribir el informe cuando su jefe llama.
Acabó de terminar de escribir el informe cuando su jefe llamó.
Había acabado de terminar el informe cuando su jefe llamaba.
q_gram_c1_06_007.explanation: 'Acabar de + инфинитив' в имперфект ('acababa de') expresses 'had just (done something)' в past. Notice double инфинитив construction: 'acababa de terminar de escribir'. The имперфект is required here для 'had just' meaning.

q_gram_c1_06_008.question: Con los años, ___ comprendiendo que la paciencia es una virtud indispensable. (ir + gerund, yo form, pretérito perfecto)
q_gram_c1_06_008.explanation: 'He ido comprendiendo' (I have gradually come к understand) uses 'ir + герундий' в present perfect к express gradual realization который connects past к present. The present perfect 'he ido' is preferred с 'con los años' потому что process is still relevant now.

q_gram_c1_06_009.question: Los vecinos andaban quejándose del ruido que provenía del local nocturno.
q_gram_c1_06_009.correct: The neighbors kept complaining about the noise that came from the nightclub.
wrong: The neighbors were walking while complaining about the nightclub noise.
The neighbors went around once to complain about the noise from the night venue.
The neighbors started to complain about the noise coming from the bar.
q_gram_c1_06_009.explanation: 'Andar + герундий' (andaban quejándose) expresses repeated, persistent action — neighbors kept complaining, не just once. It carries nuance ongoing, somewhat aimless repetition. 'Provenía' (имперфект provenir) указывает на noise was continuing source disturbance.

q_gram_c1_06_010.question: Tras la reunión, el director ___ a redactar el acta inmediatamente. (proceder, pretérito indefinido, él form)
q_gram_c1_06_010.explanation: 'Proceder + инфинитив' является formal periphrasis meaning 'к proceed к do something'. It implies deliberate, methodical beginning action, common в administrative и legal language. The pretérito indefinido 'procedió' marks completed single action.
q_gram_c1_06_010.conjugation_info: proceder (pretérito indefinido): procedí, procediste, procedió, procedimos, procedisteis, procedieron

q_gram_c1_07_001.question: Mi hermano ___ muy listo, siempre saca las mejores notas. (ser)
q_gram_c1_07_001.explanation: 'Ser listo' означает 'к be clever/smart' as inherent characteristic. By contrast, 'estar listo' означает 'к be ready'. The sentence talks about постоянный trait (always gets best grades), поэтому 'ser' is required.

q_gram_c1_07_002.question: La puerta ___ abierta por el conserje todas las mañanas a las siete. (ser)
q_gram_c1_07_002.explanation: This является habitual passive с 'ser' ('es abierta por el conserje'). When agent is specified ('por el conserje') и focus is на action being performed, 'ser + past причастие' формах passive voice. 'Estar abierta' would describe resulting state, не action.

q_gram_c1_07_003.question: What is difference between 'ser malo' и 'estar malo' в Spanish?
q_gram_c1_07_003.correct: 'Ser malo' means 'to be bad/evil' (inherent quality), while 'estar malo' means 'to be sick/ill' (temporary condition)
wrong: 'Ser malo' is used for food and 'estar malo' is used for people
Both mean 'to be bad' but 'estar malo' is more formal
'Ser malo' is for present situations and 'estar malo' is for past situations
q_gram_c1_07_003.explanation: The ser/estar distinction с 'malo' creates complete meaning change: 'Ese hombre es malo' (который man is evil/плохой) vs. 'Ese hombre está malo' (который man is sick/unwell). This is one most important ser/estar contrasts at C1 level, where meaning shifts являются tested.

q_gram_c1_07_004.question: Todavía no ___ decidido si aceptaremos la oferta. (estar, present indicative, nosotros form → resultative estar)
q_gram_c1_07_004.explanation: 'Estar decidido' describes resulting state decision process. 'No estamos decididos' означает 'we haven't made up our minds yet' — decision state has не been reached. 'Ser decidido' would mean 'к be decisive person' (character trait).
q_gram_c1_07_004.conjugation_info: estar (present indicative): estoy, estás, está, estamos, estáis, están

q_gram_c1_07_005.question: El café ___ frío; lo calentaré en el microondas. (estar)
q_gram_c1_07_005.explanation: 'Estar frío' describes временный, changeable state coffee. If we used 'ser frío', it would describe inherent characteristic (e.g., 'это drink является холодный type drink'). Since coffee has cooled down от warm state, 'estar' is correct.

q_gram_c1_07_006.question: La novela ___ escrita por García Márquez en 1967. (ser, pretérito indefinido, ella form — passive voice with agent)
q_gram_c1_07_006.explanation: When expressing passive voice с specified agent ('por García Márquez') и completed action в past, 'ser' в pretérito indefinido ('fue escrita') is correct. 'Estar' would describe resulting state novel, не act writing.
q_gram_c1_07_006.conjugation_info: ser (pretérito indefinido): fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron

q_gram_c1_07_007.question: La ventana ya ___ reparada cuando llegamos; el cristalero había venido por la mañana. (estar)
q_gram_c1_07_007.explanation: 'Estar + past причастие' describes resultative state: window was already в repaired state when we arrived. The имперфект 'estaba' используется потому что it describes ongoing state at time arrival. 'Ser' would indicate passive action repairing, не resulting condition.

q_gram_c1_07_008.question: My brother is very boring at parties, but my sister is bored because she has nothing to do.
q_gram_c1_07_008.correct: Mi hermano es muy aburrido en las fiestas, pero mi hermana está aburrida porque no tiene nada que hacer.
wrong: Mi hermano está muy aburrido en las fiestas, pero mi hermana es aburrida porque no tiene nada que hacer.
Mi hermano es muy aburrido en las fiestas, pero mi hermana es aburrida porque no tiene nada que hacer.
Mi hermano está aburrido en las fiestas, pero mi hermana está aburrida porque no tiene nada que hacer.
q_gram_c1_07_008.explanation: 'Ser aburrido' означает 'к be скучный' (inherent characteristic brother), while 'estar aburrido' означает 'к be bored' (временное состояние sister). This ser/estar contrast с same adjective producing different meanings является key C1 concept.

q_gram_c1_07_009.question: El acusado ___ absuelto por el tribunal tras un largo juicio. (ser, pretérito indefinido, passive voice, él form)
q_gram_c1_07_009.explanation: 'Fue absuelto por el tribunal' является passive construction с 'ser'. The agent ('por el tribunal') confirms passive voice requires 'ser', не 'estar'. The pretérito indefinido marks это as completed one-time event.
q_gram_c1_07_009.conjugation_info: ser (pretérito indefinido, passive): fue absuelto/a, fueron absueltos/as — used с agent phrase (por + agent)

q_gram_c1_07_010.question: Juan es muy vivo y siempre encuentra soluciones creativas, pero hoy está vivo de milagro tras el accidente.
q_gram_c1_07_010.correct: Juan is very sharp/clever and always finds creative solutions, but today he is alive by a miracle after the accident.
wrong: Juan is very alive and always finds creative solutions, but today he is living by a miracle after the accident.
Juan is very lively and always finds solutions, but today he is vivid by miracle after the accident.
Juan is very bright and always finds creative solutions, but today he is energetic miraculously after the accident.
q_gram_c1_07_010.explanation: 'Ser vivo' означает 'к be sharp/clever/quick-witted' (personality trait), while 'estar vivo' означает 'к be alive' (state being). This dramatic contrast в same sentence illustrates how ser/estar can completely change meaning adjective 'vivo'.

q_gram_c1_08_001.question: Dijo la profesora que el examen ___ más difícil de lo esperado. (ser, future indicative → VS inversion in reported speech)
q_gram_c1_08_001.explanation: In literary/formal reported speech с subject-verb inversion ('dijo la profesora'), verb в subordinate clause shifts к условное наклонение ('sería') following sequence tenses. The inversion 'dijo la profesora' (instead 'la profesora dijo') является stylistic choice common в literary и journalistic Spanish.
q_gram_c1_08_001.conjugation_info: ser (условное наклонение): sería, serías, sería, seríamos, seríais, serían

q_gram_c1_08_002.question: Bien ___ los antiguos que la sabiduría empieza con el asombro. (saber, pretérito imperfecto — literary VS inversion)
q_gram_c1_08_002.explanation: In literary Spanish, subject can be placed after verb для stylistic effect: 'Bien sabían los antiguos' instead 'Los antiguos bien sabían'. The имперфект 'sabían' используется потому что это refers к general, habitual knowledge held by ancients.

q_gram_c1_08_003.question: Grande ___ la sorpresa de todos cuando se anunció el ganador. (ser, pretérito indefinido — fronted complement)
q_gram_c1_08_003.explanation: This sentence fronts adjective 'grande' для emphasis: 'Grande fue la sorpresa' instead 'La sorpresa fue grande'. This topicalization, placing complement before verb, является literary device для dramatic effect. The pretérito indefinido 'fue' marks specific, completed event.

q_gram_c1_08_004.question: What is 'topicalization' в Spanish syntax, и what effect does it create?
q_gram_c1_08_004.correct: Moving a constituent (object, complement, adverb) to the beginning of the sentence for emphasis or contrast, often triggering subject-verb inversion
wrong: Changing the topic of a conversation mid-sentence using a discourse marker
Using a topical vocabulary item as the subject of every sentence in a paragraph
Repeating the main topic at the beginning and end of a sentence for clarity
q_gram_c1_08_004.explanation: Topicalization является syntactic process where non-subject element is fronted к sentence-initial position. In Spanish, это often triggers VS (verb-subject) inversion: 'Ese libro lo compré ayer' (который книга, I bought yesterday). It creates emphasis, contrast, или connects к preceding discourse.

q_gram_c1_08_005.question: Así lo ___ el tribunal y así se cumplirá. (determinar, pretérito perfecto, él form — formal/legal VS inversion)
q_gram_c1_08_005.explanation: In legal и formal language, fronted adverbials like 'así' often trigger VS inversion. 'Así lo ha determinado el tribunal' places emphasis на manner ('así' = thus) rather than agent. The present perfect connects past ruling к its current relevance.
q_gram_c1_08_005.conjugation_info: determinar (pretérito perfecto): he determinado, has determinado, ha determinado, hemos determinado, habéis determinado, han determinado

q_gram_c1_08_006.question: A sus hijos ___ dedicó toda su vida y su energía. (pronoun needed for left dislocation)
q_gram_c1_08_006.explanation: 'A sus hijos' является left-dislocated indirect object, moved к front sentence для emphasis. In Spanish, left dislocation requires resumptive pronoun ('les') который agrees с dislocated element. 'A sus hijos les dedicó toda su vida' = 'It was к her дети который she devoted her whole life'.

q_gram_c1_08_007.question: Never in my life have I seen such a spectacular sunset.
q_gram_c1_08_007.correct: Nunca en mi vida he visto una puesta de sol tan espectacular.
wrong: Nunca he visto en mi vida una tan espectacular puesta de sol.
En mi vida nunca había visto un atardecer así de espectacular.
Jamás en la vida mía vi tal espectacular puesta de sol.
q_gram_c1_08_007.explanation: The fronted negative adverb 'nunca en mi vida' triggers subject-verb inversion в English ('have I seen') но в Spanish, word order remains more natural: 'Nunca... he visto'. Spanish does не require auxiliary inversion after fronted negatives as English does.

q_gram_c1_08_008.question: Eso ___ lo que queríamos decirte desde el principio. (ser, pretérito imperfecto — pseudo-cleft/fronted demonstrative)
q_gram_c1_08_008.explanation: 'Eso era lo que queríamos decirte' является pseudo-cleft sentence с fronted demonstrative. The имперфект 'era' используется потому что situation spans period в past ('desde el principio'). Fronting 'eso' emphasizes identity between what is being said now и what was intended все along.

q_gram_c1_08_009.question: Mucho me temo que no será posible atender su solicitud en los plazos previstos.
q_gram_c1_08_009.correct: I very much fear that it will not be possible to address your request within the expected deadlines.
wrong: I am very afraid that your request cannot be attended in the predicted terms.
Much I fear that it won't be possible to attend to your solicitation in the foreseen timeframes.
I greatly fear that it is impossible to handle your application in the planned periods.
q_gram_c1_08_009.explanation: 'Mucho me temo que' features inversion adverb 'mucho' к sentence-initial position для formal effect. This является fixed formal expression meaning 'I very much fear который'. 'Atender su solicitud' означает 'к address/process your request', и 'en los plazos previstos' означает 'within expected deadlines'.

q_gram_c1_08_010.question: Tal ___ la magnitud del desastre que el gobierno declaró el estado de emergencia. (ser, pretérito indefinido — fronted 'tal' for emphasis)
q_gram_c1_08_010.explanation: 'Tal fue la magnitud' fronts 'tal' (such) для dramatic emphasis, literary construction. The pretérito indefinido 'fue' marks completed event. This structure is equivalent к 'La magnitud del desastre fue tal que...' но inversion creates more dramatic, literary tone.
q_gram_c1_08_010.conjugation_info: ser (pretérito indefinido): fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron — common в literary fronted constructions: 'Tal fue...', 'Grande fue...', 'Así fue...'

q_gram_c1_09_001.question: Te presto el coche ___ lo devuelvas antes del viernes. (con tal de que)
q_gram_c1_09_001.explanation: 'Con tal de que' (provided который/as long as) является условное наклонение conjunction который requires сослагательное наклонение. It establishes condition under который speaker is willing к lend car. The full форма 'con tal de que' is standard; 'con tal que' exists colloquially но 'con tal de que' is preferred в careful usage.

q_gram_c1_09_002.question: No firmaré el contrato ___ mi abogado lo revise primero. (a menos que)
q_gram_c1_09_002.explanation: 'A menos que' (unless) introduces negative condition и always triggers сослагательное наклонение. The sentence означает 'I won't sign unless my lawyer reviews it first'. While 'no ser que' и 'salvo que' have similar meanings, blank specifically requires 'menos que'.

q_gram_c1_09_003.question: What is difference between 'dado que' и 'fin de que' в terms mood selection?
q_gram_c1_09_003.correct: 'Dado que' takes the indicative because it introduces a known fact or reason, while 'a fin de que' takes the subjunctive because it introduces a purpose or goal
wrong: Both take the subjunctive because they introduce subordinate clauses
'Dado que' takes the subjunctive and 'a fin de que' takes the indicative
Both can take either mood depending on the speaker's certainty
q_gram_c1_09_003.explanation: 'Dado que' (given который/since) является causal conjunction stating established facts, поэтому it takes indicative: 'Dado que llueve, no saldremos'. 'A fin de que' (в order который/поэтому который) expresses purpose, который is inherently non-factual, поэтому it always takes сослагательное наклонение: 'Lo hice fin de que entendieras'.

q_gram_c1_09_004.question: Llegaremos a tiempo siempre y cuando no ___ tráfico en la autopista. (haber, present subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_09_004.explanation: 'Siempre y cuando' (as long as/provided который) является условное наклонение conjunction который always requires сослагательное наклонение. The present сослагательное наклонение 'haya' is needed потому что condition refers к future possibility. 'Hay' (indicative) would be grammatically incorrect after это conjunction.
q_gram_c1_09_004.conjugation_info: haber (present сослагательное наклонение): haya, hayas, haya, hayamos, hayáis, hayan

q_gram_c1_09_005.question: Organizaron la manifestación ___ las autoridades tomaran conciencia del problema. (a fin de que)
q_gram_c1_09_005.explanation: 'A fin de que' (в order который/поэтому который) является purpose conjunction который triggers сослагательное наклонение. It is more formal than 'para que' и обычно appears в written или formal spoken Spanish. The full форма с 'de' is required: 'fin de que', не 'fin que'.

q_gram_c1_09_006.question: No podremos empezar la obra a menos que el ayuntamiento nos ___ el permiso. (conceder, present subjunctive, él form)
q_gram_c1_09_006.explanation: 'A menos que' (unless) requires сослагательное наклонение. Since main clause is в future ('no podremos'), subordinate clause uses present сослагательное наклонение 'conceda' к express condition который must be met.
q_gram_c1_09_006.conjugation_info: conceder (present сослагательное наклонение): conceda, concedas, conceda, concedamos, concedáis, concedan

q_gram_c1_09_007.question: Aceptaremos el acuerdo ___ no se modifiquen las cláusulas esenciales. (siempre y cuando)
q_gram_c1_09_007.explanation: 'Siempre y cuando' is more emphatic и formal than 'siempre que'. Both mean 'provided который/as long as' и require сослагательное наклонение, но 'siempre y cuando' adds extra emphasis к conditionality.

q_gram_c1_09_008.question: We organized the event so that the community would have a space for dialogue.
q_gram_c1_09_008.correct: Organizamos el evento a fin de que la comunidad tuviera un espacio de diálogo.
wrong: Organizamos el evento para la comunidad tener un espacio de diálogo.
Organizamos el evento dado que la comunidad tenía un espacio de diálogo.
Organizamos el evento a fin de que la comunidad tiene un espacio de diálogo.
q_gram_c1_09_008.explanation: 'A fin de que' + сослагательное наклонение expresses purpose. Since main verb is в past ('organizamos' в претерит), subordinate clause uses имперфект сослагательное наклонение 'tuviera' (sequence tenses). The indicative 'tiene' would be ungrammatical after 'fin de que'.

q_gram_c1_09_009.question: Dado que las circunstancias ___ cambiado drásticamente, debemos replantear toda la estrategia. (haber, present perfect indicative, third person plural)
q_gram_c1_09_009.explanation: 'Dado que' (given который) takes indicative потому что it introduces factual premise. The present perfect indicative 'han cambiado' states fact: circumstances have changed. Using сослагательное наклонение 'hayan' would be incorrect потому что 'dado que' does не trigger сослагательное наклонение.
q_gram_c1_09_009.conjugation_info: haber (present indicative): he, has, ha, hemos, habéis, han — used as auxiliary в perfect tenses

q_gram_c1_09_010.question: Con tal de que todos los miembros estén de acuerdo, procederemos con la votación sin más demora.
q_gram_c1_09_010.correct: Provided that all the members agree, we will proceed with the vote without further delay.
wrong: So that all the members agree, we will proceed with the voting without more delay.
Given that all members are in agreement, we will proceed with the immediate vote.
As long as all members will agree, we shall proceed with voting with no more delay.
q_gram_c1_09_010.explanation: 'Con tal de que' означает 'provided который' и establishes condition. 'Estén de acuerdo' (present сослагательное наклонение estar) reflects uncertain nature condition. 'Sin más demora' является formal expression meaning 'without further delay'.

q_gram_c1_10_001.question: Terminada la reunión, los delegados ___ a sus respectivas oficinas. (regresar, pretérito indefinido, ellos form — absolute participle clause)
q_gram_c1_10_001.explanation: 'Terminada la reunión' is absolute причастие clause (participio absoluto) который replaces temporal clause: 'Cuando/Después de que se terminó la reunión'. The main clause uses pretérito indefinido потому что it describes completed action который followed meeting.
q_gram_c1_10_001.conjugation_info: regresar (pretérito indefinido): regresé, regresaste, regresó, regresamos, regresasteis, regresaron

q_gram_c1_10_002.question: Es imposible ___ sin que alguien se oponga. (aprobar la ley → infinitive replacing que + subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_10_002.explanation: When subject main clause is impersonal ('es imposible'), инфинитив can replace 'que + сослагательное наклонение' для conciseness: 'Es imposible aprobar la ley' vs. 'Es imposible que se apruebe la ley'. Both являются correct, но инфинитив construction is more concise.

q_gram_c1_10_003.question: Resueltos ___ los problemas técnicos, el lanzamiento pudo llevarse a cabo según lo previsto. (already/once — what word is implied before 'resueltos'?)
q_gram_c1_10_003.explanation: In absolute причастие clauses, 'ya' (already) is often implied или explicitly stated before причастие: '(Ya) resueltos los problemas técnicos' = 'Once technical problems had been resolved'. The причастие agrees с noun: 'resueltos' (мужского рода множественного числа) matches 'problemas'.

q_gram_c1_10_004.question: What is 'absolute причастие clause' (cláusula de participio absoluto) в Spanish?
q_gram_c1_10_004.correct: A subordinate clause with a past participle and its own subject, independent from the main clause, functioning as a temporal or causal adverbial
wrong: A clause that uses the absolute superlative form of an adjective
A participial phrase that modifies the subject of the main clause directly
A clause using the gerund that can stand alone as a complete sentence
q_gram_c1_10_004.explanation: Absolute причастие clauses like 'Terminada la obra' (work being finished) have their own subject ('la obra') distinct от main clause subject. The причастие agrees в gender и number с its subject. These clauses являются hallmark formal, literary Spanish и replace temporal/causal subordinate clauses.

q_gram_c1_10_005.question: Vistas las pruebas, el juez ___ dictar sentencia. (proceder, pretérito indefinido, él form — absolute participle + main clause)
q_gram_c1_10_005.explanation: 'Vistas las pruebas' (evidence having been examined) is absolute причастие clause common в legal Spanish. The женского рода множественного числа 'vistas' agrees с 'las pruebas'. The main clause uses pretérito indefinido потому что sentencing was single completed action.
q_gram_c1_10_005.conjugation_info: proceder (pretérito indefinido): procedí, procediste, procedió, procedimos, procedisteis, procedieron

q_gram_c1_10_006.question: Los estudiantes salieron del aula ___ terminado el examen. (preposition needed for temporal meaning: 'upon having')
q_gram_c1_10_006.explanation: The compound герундий 'habiendo terminado' (having finished) creates герундий clause expressing immediate anteriority. While 'tras haber terminado' и 'después de haber terminado' являются also valid, герундий форма is most concise clause reduction technique.

q_gram_c1_10_007.question: Once all the formalities had been completed, the transfer of property took place.
q_gram_c1_10_007.correct: Cumplidas todas las formalidades, se efectuó la transferencia de la propiedad.
wrong: Cuando se cumplieron todas las formalidades, la transferencia tuvo lugar.
Habiendo cumplido las formalidades, la propiedad fue transferida.
Después de completar los trámites, ocurrió la transferencia del inmueble.
q_gram_c1_10_007.explanation: 'Cumplidas todas las formalidades' is absolute причастие clause — most concise way к express temporal relationship. The причастие 'cumplidas' agrees с 'formalidades' (женского рода множественного числа). This construction is characteristic legal и formal register.

q_gram_c1_10_008.question: No veo la necesidad de ___ ese tema ahora. (discutir → infinitive replacing 'que discutamos')
q_gram_c1_10_008.explanation: When subjects main и subordinate clauses overlap (yo/nosotros), инфинитив can replace 'que + сослагательное наклонение': 'No veo la necesidad de discutir' is simpler than 'No veo la necesidad de que discutamos'. This clause reduction is natural и preferred в fluent Spanish.

q_gram_c1_10_009.question: Dicho lo cual, el embajador abandonó la sala sin mediar más explicaciones.
q_gram_c1_10_009.correct: Having said that, the ambassador left the room without offering any further explanation.
wrong: Saying which, the ambassador abandoned the room without mediating more explanations.
That being said, the ambassador quit the room with no middle ground for explanations.
Which having been said, the ambassador went out of the room without more words.
q_gram_c1_10_009.explanation: 'Dicho lo cual' (having said который / который having been said) is absolute причастие construction used as discourse linker. 'Sin mediar más explicaciones' означает 'without offering further explanation' — 'mediar' here означает 'к intervene/offer'.

q_gram_c1_10_010.question: Oídas las partes, el tribunal ___ la sentencia en un plazo de diez días. (emitir, future indicative, él form — legal register after absolute participle)
q_gram_c1_10_010.explanation: 'Oídas las partes' (parties having been heard) is absolute причастие clause в legal register. The future indicative 'emitirá' указывает на tribunal's obligation к issue ruling. This is standard legal language для procedural descriptions.
q_gram_c1_10_010.conjugation_info: emitir (future indicative): emitiré, emitirás, emitirá, emitiremos, emitiréis, emitirán

q_gram_c1_11_001.question: Fue María ___ resolvió el problema, no Pedro. (relative pronoun for cleft sentence)
q_gram_c1_11_001.explanation: This является cleft sentence (oración hendida): 'Fue María quien resolvió el problema'. The construction 'ser + focused element + quien/que' isolates и emphasizes 'María' as agent. 'Quien' используется для people в cleft sentences, though 'la que' is also acceptable в some dialects.

q_gram_c1_11_002.question: Lo que necesitamos ___ más tiempo para completar la investigación. (ser, present indicative)
q_gram_c1_11_002.explanation: This является pseudo-cleft sentence (oración pseudohendida): 'Lo que necesitamos es más tiempo'. The structure 'lo que + clause + ser + focused element' emphasizes information after 'ser'. The present indicative 'es' используется потому что need is current.

q_gram_c1_11_003.question: What is difference between cleft sentence и pseudo-cleft sentence в Spanish?
q_gram_c1_11_003.correct: A cleft sentence uses 'ser + focused element + que/quien' (Fue Juan quien llamó), while a pseudo-cleft uses 'lo que + clause + ser + focus' (Lo que quiero es paz)
wrong: Cleft sentences emphasize the verb and pseudo-clefts emphasize the subject
Cleft sentences are only used in questions and pseudo-clefts in statements
There is no structural difference; the terms are interchangeable in Spanish grammar
q_gram_c1_11_003.explanation: Cleft sentences (hendidas) front focused element after 'ser': 'Fue ayer cuando lo vi'. Pseudo-clefts (pseudohendidas) use free relative clause с 'lo que': 'Lo que me molesta es su actitud'. Both serve к highlight specific information, но с different syntactic structures.

q_gram_c1_11_004.question: Fue precisamente en Barcelona donde se ___ la primera reunión del comité. (celebrar, pretérito indefinido, pasiva refleja)
q_gram_c1_11_004.explanation: This cleft sentence emphasizes location: 'Fue en Barcelona donde se celebró...' The pasiva refleja 'se celebró' (was held) is standard way к express passive meaning without agent. The pretérito indefinido marks completed past event.
q_gram_c1_11_004.conjugation_info: celebrar (pretérito indefinido): celebré, celebraste, celebró, celebramos, celebrasteis, celebraron

q_gram_c1_11_005.question: A mí, lo que más me ___ es la falta de transparencia por parte del gobierno. (preocupar)
q_gram_c1_11_005.explanation: 'A mí' является left-dislocated element для emphasis, doubled by resumptive pronoun 'me'. The pseudo-cleft 'lo que más me preocupa' emphasizes focused element 'la falta de transparencia'. The verb 'preocupa' agrees с единственного числа subject 'lo que'.

q_gram_c1_11_006.question: Fue entonces cuando el presidente ___ su dimisión ante la asamblea. (presentar, pretérito indefinido, él form — temporal cleft sentence)
q_gram_c1_11_006.explanation: 'Fue entonces cuando' является temporal cleft construction который emphasizes moment action. The pretérito indefinido 'presentó' is required потому что resignation was single, completed event at который specific moment.
q_gram_c1_11_006.conjugation_info: presentar (pretérito indefinido): presenté, presentaste, presentó, presentamos, presentasteis, presentaron

q_gram_c1_11_007.question: El problema, ___ lo ve el comité, requiere una solución inmediata. (según/tal como — right dislocation marker)
q_gram_c1_11_007.explanation: 'El problema, según lo ve el comité' uses parenthetical clause который functions similarly к right dislocation, inserting committee's perspective mid-sentence. 'Según' (according к/as) introduces это viewpoint clause without disrupting main sentence structure.

q_gram_c1_11_008.question: What I really want is для them к understand severity situation.
q_gram_c1_11_008.correct: Lo que realmente quiero es que comprendan la gravedad de la situación.
wrong: Qué realmente quiero es que ellos entienden la severidad de la situación.
Lo que de verdad quiero es ellos comprender la seriedad de la situación.
Realmente lo que quiero es comprendan la gravedad de la situación.
q_gram_c1_11_008.explanation: This является pseudo-cleft sentence: 'Lo que quiero es que + сослагательное наклонение'. The сослагательное наклонение 'comprendan' is required after 'quiero que' (volition trigger). 'Gravedad' is correct translation для 'severity/seriousness' в это context, не false friend 'severidad'.

q_gram_c1_11_009.question: Ni siquiera el director ___ capaz de resolver semejante dilema ético. (ser, conditional, él form — focus particle 'ni siquiera')
q_gram_c1_11_009.explanation: 'Ni siquiera' (не even) является focus particle который emphasizes unexpectedness subject ('el director'). The условное наклонение 'sería' expresses hypothetical assessment. Focus particles like 'ni siquiera', 'incluso', 'hasta', и 'solo' являются key emphatic devices at C1 level.
q_gram_c1_11_009.conjugation_info: ser (условное наклонение): sería, serías, sería, seríamos, seríais, serían

q_gram_c1_11_010.question: Lo que me resulta verdaderamente incomprensible es que nadie haya denunciado semejante irregularidad.
q_gram_c1_11_010.correct: What I find truly incomprehensible is that nobody has reported such an irregularity.
wrong: What results truly incomprehensible to me is that nobody denounced such an irregularity.
That which I find really incomprehensible is that no one would report a similar irregularity.
What seems incomprehensible to me is that anyone reported this kind of irregularity.
q_gram_c1_11_010.explanation: This pseudo-cleft sentence emphasizes speaker's bewilderment. 'Resultar' here означает 'к find/к seem' (не 'к result'). 'Haya denunciado' (present perfect сослагательное наклонение) используется after 'es incomprensible que' потому что it expresses subjective judgment about completed action. 'Semejante' означает 'such/ это kind'.

q_gram_c1_12_001.question: En España se dice 'vosotros habláis', pero en Latinoamérica se dice 'ustedes ___'. (hablar, present indicative, ustedes form)
q_gram_c1_12_001.explanation: In Latin America, 'vosotros' does не exist. The second person множественного числа is always 'ustedes' с third-person verb формах: 'ustedes hablan'. In Spain, 'vosotros habláis' is informal и 'ustedes hablan' is formal. This is one most fundamental regional differences.
q_gram_c1_12_001.conjugation_info: hablar — Spain: vosotros habláis (informal), ustedes hablan (formal) | Latin America: ustedes hablan (both formal и informal)

q_gram_c1_12_002.question: En Argentina: '¿Vos ___ venir a la fiesta esta noche?' (querer, voseo, present indicative)
q_gram_c1_12_002.explanation: Argentine voseo conjugates -er verbs в present indicative с stress на last syllable: 'vos querés'. The diphthong 'ie' в 'quieres' does не occur потому что stress shifts к окончание. Chilean voseo would use 'querís', но Argentine standard is 'querés'.

q_gram_c1_12_003.question: En España es común oír: 'Le vi a Juan en el parque.' Esto es un ejemplo de ___.
q_gram_c1_12_003.explanation: Leísmo is use 'le' instead 'lo' для мужского рода direct object (referring к people). Standard Spanish requires 'Lo vi Juan', но в much Spain, particularly Castile, 'Le vi Juan' is widespread и even accepted by RAE для мужского рода единственного числа human referents.

q_gram_c1_12_004.question: What is main difference between Spain и Latin America regarding use pretérito perfecto (he cantado) и pretérito indefinido (canté)?
q_gram_c1_12_004.correct: In Spain, the pretérito perfecto is used for recent or same-day past events ('hoy he comido'), while in much of Latin America, the pretérito indefinido is preferred even for recent events ('hoy comí')
wrong: Latin America uses the pretérito perfecto more frequently than Spain for all past events
There is no difference; both regions use the tenses identically
Spain only uses the pretérito indefinido and Latin America only uses the pretérito perfecto
q_gram_c1_12_004.explanation: This является major regional grammar difference. In Peninsular Spanish, 'Esta mañana he desayunado temprano' is natural, но в Mexican, Argentine, и other Latin American varieties, 'Esta mañana desayuné temprano' is preferred. The pretérito perfecto в Latin America is обычно reserved для actions с clear present relevance.

q_gram_c1_12_005.question: En el voseo rioplatense, el imperativo de 'venir' es: '¡___!' (venir, voseo imperative)
q_gram_c1_12_005.explanation: The voseo повелительное наклонение 'venir' is 'vení' (stress на final syllable). This is formed by dropping -r от инфинитив и adding accent на final vowel: venir → vení. Compare с tuteo повелительное наклонение 'ven' и vosotros повелительное наклонение 'venid'.
q_gram_c1_12_005.conjugation_info: venir (voseo повелительное наклонение): vení — compare: tú ven, vosotros venid | Other examples: decir → decí, salir → salí, poner → poné

q_gram_c1_12_006.question: La ___ di el regalo a María, no a su hermana. (pronoun: 'to her' — example of laísmo if 'la' is used)
q_gram_c1_12_006.explanation: 'Le' is correct indirect object pronoun для 'María'. Using 'la' here would be laísmo — incorrect use 'la' as indirect object pronoun для женского рода referents. Laísmo is common в parts central Spain но is не accepted by RAE.

q_gram_c1_12_007.question: In Colombia, they often say 'usted' even between close friends and family members.
q_gram_c1_12_007.correct: En Colombia, a menudo dicen 'usted' incluso entre amigos cercanos y familiares.
wrong: En Colombia, normalmente dicen 'tú' incluso entre amigos y familia.
En Colombia, frecuentemente utilizan 'vosotros' entre amigos íntimos.
En Colombia, suelen decir 'vos' solamente entre amigos cercanos y familia.
q_gram_c1_12_007.explanation: In many Colombian regions (especially Bogotá и Andean highlands), 'usted' используется between close friends, семья members, и even romantic partners, without conveying formality. This является distinctive regional feature where 'usted' has lost its formal connotation в intimate contexts.

q_gram_c1_12_008.question: En España: 'He ___ a casa hace un rato.' En México: '___ a casa hace un rato.' (llegar — contrast pretérito perfecto vs. pretérito indefinido)
q_gram_c1_12_008.explanation: In Spain, pretérito perfecto 'he llegado' is natural для recent event ('hace un rato' = while ago). In Mexico, pretérito indefinido 'llegué' is strongly preferred для same context. This demonstrates core regional difference в past tense usage.

q_gram_c1_12_009.question: Che, ¿por qué no nos juntamos mañana y tomamos unos mates?
q_gram_c1_12_009.correct: Hey, why don't we get together tomorrow and have some mate (tea)?
wrong: Hey, why don't we meet tomorrow and take some checkmates?
Friend, why don't we gather tomorrow and drink some coffees?
Buddy, why didn't we get together tomorrow to take some mates?
q_gram_c1_12_009.explanation: 'Che' is Argentine/Uruguayan interjection used к get attention или express camaraderie (similar к 'hey' или 'mate'). 'Juntarse' означает 'к get together' (Rioplatense usage). 'Tomar unos mates' refers к drinking mate, traditional South American herbal tea, который is central к Argentine social culture.

q_gram_c1_12_010.question: En las Islas Canarias, el sistema pronominal se parece más al de Latinoamérica: se usa 'ustedes' en lugar de ___. (pronoun, vosotros form)
q_gram_c1_12_010.explanation: The Canary Islands, despite being part Spain, share several linguistic features с Latin American Spanish, including absence 'vosotros'. Canarian Spanish uses 'ustedes' для both formal и informal second person множественного числа, just like Latin American varieties.
q_gram_c1_12_010.conjugation_info: Canarian Spanish pronoun system: yo, tú, usted, nosotros, ustedes (no vosotros), ellos — identical к most Latin American systems

q_gram_c1_13_001.question: El profesor dijo que el examen ___ el lunes siguiente. (ser, reported speech backshift)
q_gram_c1_13_001.explanation: In reported speech, when reporting verb is в past ('dijo'), original future 'será' shifts к условное наклонение 'sería'. This backshift (correlación de tiempos) is obligatory в formal Spanish: 'El examen será el lunes' → El profesor dijo que 'el examen sería el lunes siguiente'.

q_gram_c1_13_002.question: María nos contó que ___ muy contenta con los resultados del proyecto. (estar, reported speech)
q_gram_c1_13_002.explanation: When original statement was 'Estoy muy contenta' (present indicative), reported speech с past reporting verb ('contó') requires backshift к имперфект indicative: 'estaba'. This is standard sequence--tenses shift: present → имперфект.

q_gram_c1_13_003.question: What happens к сослагательное наклонение mood в reported speech when reporting verb is в past?
q_gram_c1_13_003.correct: The present subjunctive shifts to the imperfect subjunctive (e.g., 'Quiero que venga' → 'Dijo que quería que viniera')
wrong: The subjunctive remains unchanged regardless of the tense of the reporting verb
The subjunctive changes to the indicative mood in all reported speech
The subjunctive shifts to the conditional in reported speech
q_gram_c1_13_003.explanation: Backshift affects сослагательное наклонение as well: present сослагательное наклонение → имперфект сослагательное наклонение, present perfect сослагательное наклонение → pluperfect сослагательное наклонение. For example: 'Espero que haya llegado' → 'Esperaba que hubiera llegado'. The mood itself (сослагательное наклонение) is preserved; only tense shifts.

q_gram_c1_13_004.question: El testigo declaró que no ___ nada sospechoso aquella noche. (ver, pluperfect indicative, él form — reported speech)
q_gram_c1_13_004.explanation: In reported speech, original претерит 'no vi nada' или present perfect 'no he visto nada' shifts к pluperfect 'no había visto nada' when reporting verb is в past ('declaró'). This maintains anteriority relationship.
q_gram_c1_13_004.conjugation_info: ver (pluperfect indicative): había visto, habías visto, había visto, habíamos visto, habíais visto, habían visto

q_gram_c1_13_005.question: La ministra aseguró que el gobierno ___ todas las medidas necesarias. (tomar, conditional — reported speech of future)
q_gram_c1_13_005.explanation: The original statement was likely 'El gobierno tomará todas las medidas necesarias' (future). In reported speech с past reporting verb 'aseguró', future 'tomará' shifts к условное наклонение 'tomaría'. This is standard future → условное наклонение backshift.

q_gram_c1_13_006.question: El médico le recomendó que ___ más ejercicio y que ___ la dieta. (hacer, cambiar, imperfect subjunctive — reported speech with subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_13_006.explanation: The original recommendation was 'Le recomiendo que haga más ejercicio y que cambie la dieta' (present сослагательное наклонение). With past reporting verb 'recomendó', both present subjunctives shift к имперфект subjunctives: haga → hiciera, cambie → cambiara.
q_gram_c1_13_006.conjugation_info: hacer (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): hiciera, hicieras, hiciera, hiciéramos, hicierais, hicieran | cambiar: cambiara, cambiaras, cambiara, cambiáramos, cambiarais, cambiaran

q_gram_c1_13_007.question: Los vecinos se ___ de que nadie les hubiera avisado del corte de agua. (quejarse, pretérito indefinido, ellos form — introducing reported complaint with subjunctive)
q_gram_c1_13_007.explanation: 'Quejarse de que' (к complain который) takes сослагательное наклонение в subordinate clause when expressing emotional reaction. The pretérito indefinido 'se quejaron' marks complaint as specific past event. The pluperfect сослагательное наклонение 'hubiera avisado' указывает на prior non-event который caused complaint.

q_gram_c1_13_008.question: The journalist reported that the authorities had already been informed of the threat.
q_gram_c1_13_008.correct: El periodista informó de que las autoridades ya habían sido informadas de la amenaza.
wrong: El periodista reportó que las autoridades ya fueron informadas de la amenaza.
El periodista informó que las autoridades ya eran informadas de la amenaza.
El periodista dijo de que las autoridades ya habían sido informando de la amenaza.
q_gram_c1_13_008.explanation: 'Informar de que' is correct construction (не 'informar que', который would be dequeísmo в reverse — или rather, 'informar que' without 'de' is actually common error called 'queísmo'). The pluperfect passive 'habían sido informadas' correctly maintains anteriority в reported speech.

q_gram_c1_13_009.question: El embajador insistió en que se ___ todos los protocolos diplomáticos al pie de la letra. (cumplir, imperfect subjunctive, pasiva refleja)
q_gram_c1_13_009.explanation: 'Insistir en que' + past reporting verb requires имперфект сослагательное наклонение в subordinate clause. 'Se cumplieran' is pasiva refleja (reflexive passive) форма, meaning 'который все diplomatic protocols be followed'. The множественного числа verb agrees с 'protocolos'.
q_gram_c1_13_009.conjugation_info: cumplir (имперфект сослагательное наклонение): cumpliera, cumplieras, cumpliera, cumpliéramos, cumplierais, cumplieran

q_gram_c1_13_010.question: El acusado negó rotundamente que hubiera participado en los hechos delictivos.
q_gram_c1_13_010.correct: The defendant categorically denied having participated in the criminal acts.
wrong: The accused rotundly denied that he had participated in the delictive facts.
The defendant flatly denied that he would have participated in the criminal events.
The accused completely denied participating in the delinquent acts.
q_gram_c1_13_010.explanation: 'Negar que' + сослагательное наклонение is standard потому что denial triggers сослагательное наклонение. 'Rotundamente' означает 'categorically/flatly' (не 'rotundly'). 'Hubiera participado' (pluperfect сослагательное наклонение) используется потому что denied action precedes denial. 'Hechos delictivos' означает 'criminal acts' (legal terminology).

q_gram_c1_14_001.question: El informe detalla los problemas; ___ también propone soluciones concretas. (este/este mismo — anaphoric reference, demonstrative)
q_gram_c1_14_001.explanation: In formal text cohesion, demonstrative 'este' (это one / latter) serves as anaphoric reference к 'el informe'. Using 'este' instead repeating 'el informe' creates textual cohesion. In academic/formal register, 'este' can refer back к most recently mentioned noun.
q_gram_c1_14_001.conjugation_info: Demonstratives для text cohesion: este/esta/estos/estas (anaphoric, refers к nearest antecedent), aquel/aquella (refers к more distant antecedent)

q_gram_c1_14_002.question: La empresa anunció cambios significativos. ___ cambios afectarán a todos los departamentos. (dichos/tales — anaphoric demonstrative)
q_gram_c1_14_002.explanation: 'Dichos' (said/aforementioned) является formal anaphoric device который refers back к previously mentioned nouns. 'Dichos cambios' = 'aforementioned changes'. This is characteristic legal, academic, и journalistic register и creates strong textual cohesion.

q_gram_c1_14_003.question: Juan estudió medicina y María también lo ___. (hacer — ellipsis with 'hacerlo')
q_gram_c1_14_003.explanation: 'Lo hizo' является pro-форма который substitutes для entire predicate 'estudió medicina', functioning like English 'did поэтому/did too'. This является форма substitution который avoids repetition и creates cohesion. The pretérito indefinido 'hizo' matches tense 'estudió'.

q_gram_c1_14_004.question: What is difference between anaphoric и cataphoric reference в text cohesion?
q_gram_c1_14_004.correct: Anaphoric reference points backward to something already mentioned (e.g., 'Juan came. He was tired'), while cataphoric reference points forward to something not yet mentioned (e.g., 'This is what I mean: we must change')
wrong: Anaphoric reference uses pronouns and cataphoric reference uses nouns
Anaphoric reference is used in writing and cataphoric reference is used in speech
Anaphoric reference connects paragraphs and cataphoric reference connects sentences
q_gram_c1_14_004.explanation: Anaphora (backward reference) is far more common: 'María llegó tarde. Ella se disculpó.' Cataphora (forward reference) creates suspense или emphasis: 'Esto es lo que quiero decir: debemos actuar ya.' Both являются essential cohesion devices, но cataphora requires more careful planning.

q_gram_c1_14_005.question: La primera propuesta fue rechazada; la segunda, en cambio, ___ aprobada por unanimidad. (ser, pretérito indefinido — ellipsis of 'propuesta fue')
q_gram_c1_14_005.explanation: This sentence uses ellipsis: 'la segunda [propuesta] fue [aprobada]' omits repeated noun 'propuesta' after ordinal. The comma after 'la segunda' marks ellipsis point. 'En cambio' (на other рука) is adversative connector creating contrast between two propositions.
q_gram_c1_14_005.conjugation_info: ser (pretérito indefinido): fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron — used в passive constructions: fue aprobada, fue rechazada

q_gram_c1_14_006.question: Los investigadores presentaron sus hallazgos. ___, el público pudo formular preguntas. (a continuación — sequential connector)
q_gram_c1_14_006.explanation: 'A continuación' (next/afterwards) является temporal sequential connector который organizes events chronologically в discourse. It signals который Q&A session followed presentation. Sequential connectors like 'continuación', 'seguidamente', и 'posteriormente' являются essential для text cohesion.

q_gram_c1_14_007.question: The results confirm the hypothesis; however, further research is needed to validate them.
q_gram_c1_14_007.correct: Los resultados confirman la hipótesis; no obstante, se necesita más investigación para validarlos.
wrong: Los resultados confirman la hipótesis; pero, se necesita investigar más para validarlas.
Los resultados confirman la hipotesis; sin embargo se necesitan más investigación para validarlos.
Los resultados confirmaron la hipótesis; no obstante, se necesitará más investigaciones para validarlos.
q_gram_c1_14_007.explanation: 'No obstante' (however/nevertheless) является formal adversative connector. The pronoun 'validarlos' refers к 'los resultados' (мужского рода множественного числа). Academic register requires impersonal 'se necesita' + единственного числа noun. Note semicolon before 'no obstante' и comma after it.

q_gram_c1_14_008.question: El gobierno implementó nuevas políticas fiscales; ___, redujo el gasto público en un 15%. (asimismo/además — additive connector for formal cohesion)
q_gram_c1_14_008.explanation: 'Asimismo' (likewise/в addition) является formal additive connector который links two complementary actions. It creates textual cohesion by showing который spending cut was additional measure alongside fiscal policies, не consequence или contrast.

q_gram_c1_14_009.question: Cabe señalar, asimismo, que los datos recopilados hasta la fecha no permiten extraer conclusiones definitivas.
q_gram_c1_14_009.correct: It should also be noted that the data collected to date do not allow definitive conclusions to be drawn.
wrong: It fits to signal, likewise, that the data compiled to the date don't permit extracting definitive conclusions.
We should point out, in addition, that the gathered data until today cannot draw final conclusions.
It is worth also signaling that the data recollected up to this date does not permit to extract conclusive definitions.
q_gram_c1_14_009.explanation: 'Cabe señalar' (it should be noted) является formal impersonal expression. 'Asimismo' (likewise/also) is positioned parenthetically between commas. 'Hasta la fecha' означает 'к date'. 'Extraer conclusiones' (к draw conclusions) является fixed collocation в academic Spanish. The entire sentence exemplifies formal academic cohesion.

q_gram_c1_14_010.question: El estudio se centró en tres variables, a saber: la edad, el nivel educativo y el ingreso mensual. El conector 'a saber' cumple una función ___. (catafórica/cataphoric, explicativa/explanatory)
q_gram_c1_14_010.explanation: 'A saber' (namely) является cataphoric connector: it points forward к information который has не yet been presented (three variables). This является textbook example cataphoric reference — colon after 'saber' introduces enumeration который follows.
q_gram_c1_14_010.conjugation_info: Cataphoric connectors: saber (namely), lo siguiente (following), esto es (который is), continuación (as follows)

q_gram_c1_15_001.question: Yo me recuerdo de aquel día perfectamente. → Correct: 'Yo ___ aquel día perfectamente.' (recordar, yo form)
